timeline_convention: Events are stable-sorted by block-relative sample_offset then ingress_sequence and apply before the addressed sample. First-capture start is inclusive and stop is exclusive. An established-loop capture starts at phase zero, records exactly N frames, and commits before the following phase-zero sample is mixed.
